brief: A resort-town house in Petoskey: Issac Bartram's house, as photographed — see the photo for its massing and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: Petoskey's resort-town streets (the town's model) were built 1880-1930, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Bartram House (Petoskey, 1900): a 1.5-storey gable-front house in vinyl with shutters on the attic window, its porch being enclosed (raw OSB sheathing, new window openings), a big hand-painted house number; a row of arborvitae

why.note: porches enclosed for winter rooms: a common alteration caught mid-work
